城市空间紧凑度与居民交通碳排放之间存在怎样的定量关系？

What quantitative relationship exists between urban compactness and residential transport emissions?

实证研究表明，在控制收入等因素后，人口密度与就业混合度越高，人均出行距离与汽车依赖越低，交通碳排放随之下降。但过度紧凑若缺乏绿地与公共服务也会抬高热岛与生活质量成本。
Empirical studies show that, controlling for income and other factors, higher population density and job mix lower per-capita trip distance and car dependence, reducing transport emissions. Yet excessive compactness without green space and services can raise heat-island and livability costs.

生命周期评价（LCA）在比较城市交通方式环境绩效时应注意什么？

What should life-cycle assessment (LCA) account for when comparing urban transport options?

LCA 需从车辆制造、能源生产到报废全链条核算能耗与排放，而非仅看行驶阶段。电动车若电网高碳则优势收窄，且电池生产与回收的隐性负担必须计入，否则会低估真实环境影响。
LCA must account for energy and emissions across manufacturing, energy production and end-of-life, not just the driving phase. An EV on a high-carbon grid loses much of its advantage, and battery production and recycling burdens must be included or the true impact is understated.

城市绿地除了降温还能在城市水循环中发挥什么作用？

Beyond cooling, what role do urban green spaces play in the urban water cycle?

绿地通过植被截留与土壤入渗削减地表径流、延缓洪峰，并借助蒸腾调节局地湿度。合理布局的绿地网络还能过滤部分雨水污染物，减轻受纳水体的富营养化压力。
Green spaces intercept rainfall and promote infiltration, reducing runoff and delaying flood peaks, while transpiration moderates local humidity. Well-placed green networks also filter some stormwater pollutants, easing eutrophication pressure on receiving waters.

什么是公交导向开发（TOD），它为何有助于低碳城市？

What is transit-oriented development (TOD) and why does it help build low-carbon cities?

TOD 围绕轨道交通与公交枢纽进行高密度、混合功能的紧凑开发，缩短出行距离并提升公共交通分担率。这能降低私人小汽车依赖与人均出行碳排放，同时提高土地与基础设施效率。
TOD concentrates high-density, mixed-use development around rail and bus hubs, shortening trip distances and raising transit mode share. It cuts reliance on private cars and per-capita transport emissions while improving land and infrastructure efficiency.

海绵城市理念如何通过自然途径缓解城市内涝与径流污染？

How does the sponge city concept use natural processes to ease urban flooding and runoff pollution?

海绵城市通过下沉绿地、透水铺装与雨水花园等吸纳、蓄滞和净化雨水，削减峰值流量并补充地下水。它把灰色排水与绿色基础设施结合，提升城市对暴雨的韧性。
Sponge cities use sunken green space, permeable pavement and rain gardens to absorb, store and cleanse stormwater, cutting peak flows and recharging groundwater. Coupling grey drainage with green infrastructure raises resilience to heavy rain.

城市慢行系统（步行与自行车网络）能带来哪些环境与健康的协同效益？

What combined environmental and health benefits do urban slow-traffic systems provide?

连续安全的步行与自行车网络替代短途机动车出行，直接减少尾气与碳排放，并增加居民体力活动从而降低慢性病风险。其效益发挥依赖路权隔离、接驳便利与治安等配套条件。
Continuous, safe walking and cycling networks replace short car trips, directly cutting exhaust and carbon emissions while increasing physical activity and lowering chronic-disease risk. Benefits depend on separated right-of-way, easy connections and perceived safety.

绿色出行里步行、骑行、公交、电动车怎么排序碳排？

How do walking, cycling, bus and EV rank by carbon per trip?

通常步行、骑行最低（近乎零），公共交通次之，电动车取决于电网清洁度，私家车（尤其单人燃油车）最高。短途优先“腿和轮”，中长途选公交地铁最划算。
Walking and cycling are near-zero, public transit next, EVs depend on grid cleanliness, and a solo gasoline car is highest. Walk or bike short trips; take transit for medium ones.

共享出行模式对城市交通碳排放的影响是否一定为正？

Does shared mobility unambiguously reduce urban transport emissions?

共享出行未必减排：若它诱发了原本步行、骑行或公交的出行需求（诱导出行），或增加空驶里程，净排放可能上升。只有在替代私人购车并提升车辆载客率时，才更可能带来减排。
Shared mobility does not necessarily cut emissions: if it induces trips that would otherwise be walked, cycled or taken by transit, or adds deadhead mileage, net emissions may rise. It is more likely to help only when it replaces car ownership and raises vehicle occupancy.
